text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of no standing zones on both sides of Village Green Square at all corners of the Village Green Square P-loop intersections. Currently, parking is prohibited on both sides of Village Green Square, from Kennedy Road to the east end of Village Green Square. Parking is permitted for a maximum period of three hours on both sides of Village Green Square within the P-loop of Village Green Square East, West and North legs respectively.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Village Green Square, between Kennedy Road and the east end of Village Green Square. 2. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Village Green Square, between Kennedy Road and a point 348 metres east of Kennedy Road. 3. Rescinded the parking prohibition at in effect at all times on the south side of Village Green Square, between a point 375.5 metres east of Kennedy Road and the east end of Village Green Square. 4. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Village Green Square (south leg), between Kennedy Road and the east end of Village Green Square (south leg). 5.
